meeting.title: Sylvera — parity sign-off
meeting.summary: Tom confirmed parity validation of the carbon ratings dashboard against Looker is complete and signed off. Go-live confidence confirmed; no new work agreed.
key_decisions: Parity sign-off recorded; July 13 go-live confirmed
meeting.notes: The July 2 decision gate passed late but clean — the last two discrepancies were confirmed as Looker timezone bugs, not data issues.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Morning Tom — I saw your message on Friday but wanted to hear it properly. Where did parity land?

transcript.speaker: Tom Whitmore
transcript.text: Parity validation is complete — every number on the carbon ratings dashboard matches Looker to the decimal. Sign-off is done, I've recorded it in the tracker.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: And the two discrepancies you flagged in the last sync?

transcript.speaker: Tom Whitmore
transcript.text: Both confirmed as timezone bugs in the old Looker explore. Your numbers were right in both cases, which honestly helped the internal pitch.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: That's the best possible outcome. So the parity task goes to done and the go-live gate is passed — July 13th holds.

transcript.speaker: Tom Whitmore
transcript.text: July 13th holds, yes. The team's actually excited — the training sessions last week went down well.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Glad to hear it. Anything new you need from us this week? I don't want to invent work — the runway is set.

transcript.speaker: Tom Whitmore
transcript.text: Nothing new. Everything left is already on the board.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Perfect. Then next time we speak it's the go-live review. Congratulations on the sign-off.

transcript.speaker: Tom Whitmore
transcript.text: Thanks Ines — see you at the review.
